translations.web: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”
translations.bsb: “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat what you find here. Eat this scroll, then go and speak to the house of Israel.”
translations.kjv: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.
translations.asv: And he said unto me, Son of man, eat that which thou findest; eat this roll, and go, speak unto the house of Israel.
